Metadata.CommitMsg:
fix: verify.sh — steam is universal-only; check NVIDIA stack on -nvidia

verify.sh hard-required steam, but steam is intentionally excluded from the
-nvidia images (Terra nvidia-driver-libs 'if steam' conditional vs the 615
32-bit tree). Detect the NVIDIA images via nvidia-driver-libs and assert
nvidia-smi + libcuda.so.1 instead.
